sources.snippet: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics has introduced Microduck, a small biped robot designed as an open development platform for experimenting with physical AI, reinforcement learning and transferring robot behaviors from simulation into real hardware.

sources.title: Hugging Face Launches Open Source Microduck Robot
sources.snippet: Hugging Face has unveiled Microduck, a 25-centimetre-tall open source robot developed with its robotics subsidiary Pollen Robotics. The duck-shaped robot is designed as an accessible platform for experimenting with physical AI and reinforcement learning, allowing developers to teach it new behaviours and deploy them on the robot.

sources.snippet: Trained From A Laptop There was a serious point behind the playful moment. Just before the robots appeared, Huang showed a video in which an AI agent took a Microduck through its training.
